name: Rui Vargas + MVRIA
description: Two major names in the Portuguese electronic scene take over the decks at Switch for what promises to be a long night of top-tier house and techno.
longDescription:
Rui Vargas and MVRIA, two prominent figures in Portugal's electronic music landscape, are set to perform at Switch on May 30, 2026. Rui Vargas, a veteran DJ and producer, has been instrumental in shaping the country's club scene for decades, known for his eclectic sets spanning various subgenres of house and techno. MVRIA, a more recent but equally impactful artist, has garnered attention for her dynamic selections and energetic performances, establishing herself as a significant voice in contemporary Portuguese electronic music. This event brings together their distinct styles for an extended night of music.

Attendees can anticipate an immersive club atmosphere at Switch, a venue known for its focused sound system and intimate setting. The event is categorized as nightlife, suggesting a late start and a duration that extends into the early hours. The audience typically comprises individuals with an interest in electronic music, ranging from seasoned club-goers to those exploring the local scene. The primary language of interaction will be Portuguese, though English is commonly understood in Porto's nightlife venues.

Tickets for Rui Vargas + MVRIA at Switch are currently available for purchase; please check for current pricing. Switch is located in central Porto, accessible via public transport. The venue is a short walk from the Trindade metro station, a major hub for multiple metro lines. Specific accessibility information for the venue is not provided. The event is not suitable for families.
